title: Interpretation & Meaning — Review
goal: Bring together double-mood verbs, doubt vs certainty, indirect questions, hedging and como si in analysis of meaning.
grammar: verbos-doble-modo, subjunctive-doubt, indirect questions, hedging, como si

items: I can contrast the indicative and subjunctive meanings of double-mood verbs such as *decir*, *sentir*, *comprender* and *suponer*.
I can calibrate doubt vs. certainty, report indirect questions and implicit hints, and contrast surface appearance with underlying meaning.
I can explain written misunderstandings with *como si* + subjunctive and precise vocabulary for tone and subtext.
